mapper.select:
select * from (
UNION ALL
UNION ALL
) order by payDate

select SEC_ACCT_ID code, SEC_ACCT_ID name, SEC_ACCT_NAME shortName, SEC_ACCT_ID hidCode FROM STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO
SEC_ACCT_ID like concat('%',concat(#{secAcctId},'%')) or SEC_ACCT_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{secAcctId},'%'))
SELECT to_char(MIN(POSITION_START_DATE), 'yyyy-MM-dd') FROM TRD_ACCOUNTMF_CONFIG WHERE SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId} AND REGIST_ORG = #{org} AND to_char(POSITION_START_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') <= #{cdate}

select count(1) from FIN_CASH_PLAN where CASH_ID = #{cashId} and CASH_NUM < #{cashNum} and not exists (select 1 from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.CASH_ID and FIN_CASH_PLAN.MDATE = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.MDATE)

UNION ALL
UNION ALL

SELECT PTL_FEE_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID ptlId, ptl.PORTFOLIO_NAME portFolioName, /*组合名称*/
PSA.ACCT_NO secAcctId,
sum(NVL(PTL_FEE_POSITION.TDY_ACCUMUL_PAY_FEE,0)) payAmt, sum(NVL(PTL_FEE_POSITION.TDY_ACCUMUL_PAY_FEE,0)) actPayAmt FROM PTL_FEE_POSITION LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO ptl ON PTL_FEE_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID = ptl.PORTFOLIO_ID
LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_ACCT PSA ON PSA.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_FEE_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID INNER JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO SSAI ON SSAI.SEC_ACCT_ID = PSA.ACCT_NO
AND SSAI.REGIST_ORG = PTL_FEE_POSITION.PTL_FEE_PLACE
WHERE PTL_FEE_POSITION.PTL_FEE_TYPE = #{feeType1} AND PTL_FEE_POSITION.CDATE = to_date(#{cdate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')-1
AND PSA.ACCT_NO = #{secAcctId}
AND PTL_FEE_POSITION.PTL_FEE_PLACE = #{org}
group by PTL_FEE_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID, ptl.PORTFOLIO_NAME
,PSA.ACCT_NO
having sum(NVL(PTL_FEE_POSITION.TDY_ACCUMUL_PAY_FEE,0)) > 0

SELECT FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID ptlId, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_NAME portFolioName, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID secAcctId, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.FINPROD_TYPE2 feeType, SUM(TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_AMT) actPayAmt, SUM(PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.THEORY_AMT) payAmt, SUM(PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.REMAIN_PRIN_AMT) adjustAmt FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL, FIN_PRODUCT, TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL, PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD, PTL_PORTFOLIO WHERE TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID =PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL.TRADE_ID AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID and FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID AND TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} GROUP BY FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_NAME, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID,TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.FINPROD_TYPE2
SELECT PAY_CYCLE FROM FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE WHERE CASH_ID = #{cashId} and eff_date <= to_date(#{mDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and ROWNUM <= 1

select dat.resiPrincipal from ( select psp.AMOUNT resiPrincipal from PTL_CASH_POSITION psp
where psp.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{ptlId} and psp.CDATE <= to_date(#{payDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') and not exists( select 1 from PTL_CASH_POSITION temp where temp.PORTFOLIO_ID = psp.PORTFOLIO_ID
and temp.CDATE> psp.CDATE AND temp.CDATE <= to_date(#{payDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') ) order by psp.CDATE desc )dat where rownum = 1

SELECT count(*) FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN inner JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO ON FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID inner JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ON FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID inner JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID inner JOIN MST_FEEINFO ON FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID = MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID AND MST_FEEINFO.CHARGE_TYPE = #{chargeType_01} and FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE <= to_date(#{mdate},'yyyy-MM-dd') and decode(MST_FEEINFO.FEE_TYPE, #{feeType_03}, 0, #{feeType_04}, 0, #{feeType_12}, 0, 1) = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.CASH_ID AND FIN_CASH_PLAN.Mdate = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.MDATE AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PS = #{ps_C11} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL = #{noFlag} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_STATUS = #{tradeStatus_01} and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId})

select DISTINCT TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID secAcctId, decode(MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID ,NULL,MST_FEEINFO1.FEE_ID,MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID)as feeId, decode(MST_FEEINFO.FEE_NAME,NULL,MST_FEEINFO1.FEE_NAME,MST_FEEINFO.FEE_NAME) as feeName, decode(MST_FEEINFO.FEE_TYPE,NULL,MST_FEEINFO1.FEE_TYPE,MST_FEEINFO.FEE_TYPE) as feeType, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.VDATE vdate, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.MDATE mdate, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.CASH_ID cashId, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID tradeId, FIN_PRODUCT.CCY ccy from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL ON TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE ON TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = PTL_TRADE.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ON TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO ON FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.CASH_ID AND FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} LEFT JOIN MST_FEEINFO ON FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID = MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ON FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID = TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN MST_FEEINFO MST_FEEINFO1 ON TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL.FEE_ID = MST_FEEINFO1.FEE_ID where TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}
select FINPROD_ID finprodId from PRD_LAYER_PARAM where P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

SELECT sum(NVL(PTL_FEE_POSITION.TDY_ACCUMUL_PAY_FEE,0)) FROM PTL_FEE_POSITION
LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_ACCT PSA ON PSA.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_FEE_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID INNER JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO SSAI ON SSAI.SEC_ACCT_ID = PSA.ACCT_NO
AND SSAI.REGIST_ORG = PTL_FEE_POSITION.PTL_FEE_PLACE
WHERE PTL_FEE_POSITION.PTL_FEE_TYPE = #{feeType1} AND PTL_FEE_POSITION.CDATE = to_date(#{cdate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')-1
AND PSA.ACCT_NO = #{secAcctId}
AND PTL_FEE_POSITION.PTL_FEE_PLACE = #{org}
AND PTL_FEE_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID IN (select BUSINESS_ID from data_auth_notify_inst where INSTITUTION_CODE = (select sd.INSTITUTION_CODE from SYS_USER su left join SYS_DEPARTMENT sd on su.DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPT_CODE where su.USER_ID= #{userId}))
select from STL_PAY_ORDERS where TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}
select from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}
select REGIST_ORG from STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO where SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId}

select FIN_PRODUCT.CCY as ccy , FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, FIN_PRODUCT.PROFIT_TYPE as profitType, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.DEAL_MODE as dealMode, FIN_PRODUCT.MDATE, mdate from FIN_PRODUCT, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD /*, PA_FIN_PRODUCT*/ where FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID /*AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PA_FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID*/
and (FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{ptlId} or FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID = (select p.parent_portfolio_id from ptl_portfolio p where PORTFOLIO_ID = #{ptlId}))
AND rownum = 1

select tpd.TRADE_ID tradeId,tpd.FINPROD_ID finprodId,tpd.vdate calcStartDate, tpd.mdate calcEndDate,ptpd.THEORY_AMT payAmt,tpd.TRADE_AMT actPayAmt,tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID ptlId from PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL ptpd, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd,TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpda where tpd.TRADE_ID =ptpd.TRADE_ID and tpda.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID and tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totleTradeId}

select SEQ_NO seqNo, /*流水号*/ FEE_TYPE feeType, /*费用品种*/ SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId, /*证券账户*/ REGIST_ORG registOrg, /*登记托管机构*/ PAY_DATE payDate, /*支付日（几号）*/ POSITION_START_DATE positionStartDate, /*计提开始日*/ POSITION_END_DATE positionEndDate, /*计提结束日*/ FEE_AMT_TOTAL feeAmtTotal /*每季费用金额*/ from TRD_ACCOUNTMF_CONFIG where DEAL_STATUS = '01' and to_char(POSITION_START_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= #{batchDate}

SELECT '${effectStatus}' effectStatus , TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID secAcctId , '' AS feeId , '' AS feeName , TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL.FEE_TYPE feeType, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.FINPROD_TYPE2 AS feeType1, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.VDATE AS VDATE , TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.MDATE AS MDATE , TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.SETTLE_DATE AS payDate , payAmt.payAmt AS feeAmt , payAmt.regTrustOrg AS regTrustOrg, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TRADE_AMT AS actPayAmt , TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID tradeId , TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.VDATE positionStartDate , TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.MDATE positionEndDate, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.INSTITUTION_CODE institutionCode, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.INSTITUTION_CODE belongInstitutionCode FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ON TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN ( select TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.REGIST_ORG regTrustOrg, SUM(PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.THEORY_AMT) payAmt from PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL,TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID =PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID group by TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID,TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.REGIST_ORG ) payAmt ON payAmt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID WHERE 1=1 AND TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TRADE_STATUS=#{effectStatus} AND TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.IS_CANCEL=#{noFlag} AND TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TG_BUSI_TYPE=#{TG_BUSI_TYPE}

select sum(p1.THEORY_INT) from PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL p1 left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t1 on p1.TRADE_ID=t1.TRADE_ID left join trd_fin_product_deal_total t2 on t1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID=t2.TOTLE_TRADE_ID where t2.TOTLE_TRADE_ID=#{totleTradeId}
